rationale: The PDF SHA-256 matches the required digest. The exact declarations preserve the conventional upper-triangular column algorithm, arbitrary ordering only within its sums, every index endpoint and coefficient, computed-versus-exact distinctions, both local estimates, the exact backward identity, and both global componentwise bounds.
